answer.text: Whether Hate may discard Morph and what others must discard to avoid losing ships.
answer.answer: Yes. Morph is a card type; if Hate discards Morph, others must discard Morph or lose three ships. They cannot substitute a card Morph might copy.

answer.text: Whether a lower attack can be discarded when Hate discarded an attack.
answer.answer: No. The attack must be equal or higher in value; a lower attack does not qualify, so that player discards nothing and loses three ships.

clauses.clause: May Hate discard Morph, and what must others then discard to avoid losing ships?

clauses.result: Yes. Draw the required starting hand before Rage is used.
